claims: For independent samples in the usual unequal-variance Welch test, the standardized difference uses an approximate Student t reference law with Welch–Satterthwaite degrees of freedom. The native specified-input axiom alone supplies no reference-law interpretation.
Apply SVD to the column-mean-centered observation matrix. The right singular vectors then give eigenvectors of the sample covariance matrix XᵀX/(n−1). This claim concerns covariance PCA.
The two ordinary conditional ratios require P(A)>0 and P(B)>0 when relating P(A|B) and P(B|A). The Mathlib passage is contrasting evidence about totalized measure conditioning.

Recognition is by final state after consuming the input, with the deterministic epsilon-transition restriction. The corresponding empty-stack convention without an end marker has a prefix-free restriction.

definition.former: The fixed points of a monotone self-map of a complete lattice form a complete lattice, with extrema in the original order.
definition.replacement: The fixed points of a monotone self-map of a complete lattice form a complete lattice under the induced order. Suprema and infima in the fixed-point lattice can differ from the corresponding bounds in the ambient lattice.
definition.subject: knaster-tarski-fixed-point-theorem

scopes.behavioral-regression: An observed degradation relative to an earlier expected behavior. The Property role concerns this comparison; regression testing is a separate method.
scopes.context-free-language: An individual language generated by some context-free grammar. In recognition claims about machine models, this subject denotes the family of all such languages.
scopes.inductive-recursion: Structural recursion over the constructors of an already specified inductive type. Induction-recursion concerns a simultaneous inductive and recursive definition.
scopes.transition-matrix: The stochastic-process subject covers transition probabilities between states, particularly in a discrete-time Markov chain.
